local_review.review_comment: Verified the single-coordinate diff shape, meaningful public-API tests in a separate package, absence of scaffold/native-skip/version-pinning/legacy-config patterns, metadata presence and scope, index integrity, and resolved statistics. Dynamic-access coverage is 17/19 (89.47%), above the new-library gate, and 17 covered calls do not trigger the 39-entry mismatch threshold. The narrow java.io and sun.nio.ch opens are required by JavaLibCHelper's reflection into JDK descriptor/channel internals: removing them reproduced three native runtime failures. The exact Forge finalizer then passed all three native lanes, metadata splitting and validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation with no publishable changes.
